answer: Like a trellis that lets only one vine climb each rung, an agent economy can require every identity to present a zero-knowledge proof tied to a distinct government-issued credential: the proof reveals only a unique nullifier, never the document itself, so one credential yields exactly one identity. A Sybil attacker cannot wander past this gate by copying data, because each fake identity needs a separate real credential, bought or stolen at full price and risk, while honest agents pay only the cost of one private proof as the tide of new registrations is checked against the nullifier registry.
